classification: SYNTHETIC SCHEMA-BASED FIXTURES; NO ACTUAL ADAPTY OR MIXPANEL RESPONSE WAS CAPTURED
amount_basis: Customer charge before fees/tax adjustments, minus the one simulated full refund
full_refund_assumption: CSV provides refunded_at but no refund amount/type; this fixture chooses one full USD6.99 refund.
adapty_json_scope: Selected documented webhook fields only. This is not a complete webhook schema fixture; e.g. proceeds_usd is intentionally omitted because the source has no commission basis.
refund_amount_convention: Positive magnitude in projected price_* fields; internal signed amount comes from event_type. Public docs reviewed did not explicitly fix the raw refund sign. Validate the adapter against a captured event before asserting real integration parity.
mixpanel_identity_assumption: No mixpanel_user_id override; distinct_id uses synthetic CUID fallback.
mixpanel_insert_id_assumption: The mock assigns the projected event UUID to $insert_id. This is an explicit mapping, not observed proof of exact equality in a real integration.
mixed_identity_fields: profile IDs and event IDs are fake. Google-format IDs are assigned by explicit fixture mapping and do not equal an actual seeder run.
time_basis: Original unshifted offline dates; no live replay time shift
inference_boundary: The oracle and mapping annotations are test controls, never model evidence. Double-tracking is the injected scenario, while duplicate economic events are the observable finding; producer root cause remains a hypothesis without producer logs.
